title: Reset and dirty state
expectedPositive: Enter a nonempty title, force server 503, and verify the field remains dirty. Repeat with 201 and confirm reset clears it.
expectedNegative: The starter resets before the HTTP response is confirmed, destroying user input on failure.
securityBoundary: Do not store private form drafts or server error bodies into telemetry by default; client state may contain sensitive data.
